parsed.draft_response:
Sorry about that—when a newly invited analyst gets an “access denied” message right after accepting the invite (while everyone else can log in), it usually indicates a workspace access/role issue for that specific user. We’ll get this escalated and work with you to restore her access as quickly as possible.

To help our team investigate today, could you please share the following?
1) Workspace name (and product/platform if you’re using more than one)
2) The exact wording of the “access denied” message (and any error code, if shown)
3) The analyst’s email/username that received the invite
4) The role/permissions you granted her in the workspace

If she can’t access the workspace at all, please also confirm whether she can see the login page and where the denial occurs (e.g., after accepting the invite, when opening the workspace link, etc.). Once we have this, we’ll proceed with the investigation on our side.
promised_actions: Request the details needed to determine the reason for the access denial
safety_notes: Do not promise resolution or a refund; issue requires human review.
Avoid claiming a specific root cause without additional details.

parsed.customer_impact: The newly invited analyst is unable to access the workspace, blocking their ability to work while other users are unaffected.

Whether any access control changes or permission updates occurred around the time of the invite.
risk_signals: An account/workspace access denial occurs for a specific newly invited user after invite acceptance, suggesting potential mis-provisioning or permission/entitlement issues for that user.
